about.label: ABOUT EDUCARE FOUNDATION
about.title: Building Brighter Futures Through Inclusive Education
about.dis: Founded in 2012 with a single classroom of twenty students, Educare Foundation now operates 25 community learning centers. We work alongside parents, local teachers, and volunteers to remove financial and social barriers so every child can read, curious minds can explore technology, and young leaders can shape their own futures.

highlights.title: 100% Free Learning
highlights.description: Zero tuition fees, free nutritious mid-day snacks, and complete stationery kits for every enrolled child.

highlights.title: Community-Led Centers
highlights.description: Local educators trained in modern, child-friendly pedagogy right within the neighborhoods that need them most.

highlights.title: Holistic Growth
highlights.description: Combining foundational literacy and numeracy with digital skills, STEAM workshops, arts, and mentorship.

ourProgram.dis: Our holistic programs meet children where they are—from early childhood play and foundational reading to digital literacy labs and girl-child scholarship support.

ourCauses.title: Seeds of Change in Action
ourCauses.description: Every contribution directly funds classroom equipment, learning kits, and mentor stipends. Choose a cause close to your heart and help us reach our goal.

causes.title: Digital Literacy for All
causes.description: Bridging the digital divide by equipping rural and urban community centers with laptops, internet access, and guided coding sessions.
causes.imageAlt: Children learning digital skills on computers

causes.title: STEAM Workshops in Rural Areas
causes.description: Inspiring young minds through hands-on science experiments, robotics kits, engineering challenges, and creative mathematics.
causes.imageAlt: Students participating in a hands-on science workshop

causes.title: The Mobile Library Initiative
causes.description: Bringing thousands of illustrated storybooks, bilingual readers, and weekly storytelling circles to remote villages.
causes.imageAlt: Children exploring books at a community library

causes.title: Art & Gardening for Empowerment
causes.description: Encouraging creativity, teamwork, nutrition awareness, and environmental stewardship through school kitchen gardens and art clubs.
causes.imageAlt: Children planting seedlings together in a garden

causes.title: School Supplies for Every Child
causes.description: Providing sturdy backpacks, notebooks, geometry boxes, and stationery kits at the start of every academic term.
causes.imageAlt: School bags and stationery prepared for students

causes.title: Girls' Education & Opportunity
causes.description: Supporting adolescent girls with scholarships, mentorship circles, and safe transport so they complete secondary school.
causes.imageAlt: Girls studying together in a supportive classroom

bottomCta.title: Be a Part of Their Learning Journey
bottomCta.description: Your support opens doors to classrooms, inspires curious young minds, and creates lasting generational change.

items.name: Anita Sharma
items.quote: My daughter now goes to class every single morning and comes home excited to read aloud to her younger brother. The teachers are patient and the learning center feels like a second home.

items.name: Daniel Okafor
items.quote: I contribute every month because Educare Foundation shares transparent impact reports showing every classroom kit and computer lab funded. It is rare to see an organization this open and effective.

items.name: Roshni Verma
items.quote: Volunteering with this team changed how I see my own community. They listen to families first, plan with local educators, and show up every week without fail. I am proud to be part of it.

items.name: Grace Mensah
items.quote: When the Mobile Library began visiting our neighborhood, children who had never owned a storybook started borrowing two books a week. Reading has become a joyful habit for the whole village.
